'''K1-Z3N''' was a [[Custodian droid (Iokath)|custodian droid]] from [[Iokath]] refurbished for use by the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
K1-Z3N appears in the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] as a Cartel companion available from the Eternal Command Pack, added with Patch 5.0.
